people.person.removeBody: {name} won’t be in the house any more. Their history stays on the Wall and in Stake history. The code changes, so they’d need a new invite to join again.
people.kids.addBody: For a child without their own phone. They don’t sign in: a parent picks them at the top of Today and ticks for them.
people.kids.name: Name
people.kids.bornMeta: So they’re only dealt Johns they’re old enough for.
people.kids.added: {name} is in. They’re dealt Johns from next week.
people.kids.noSignIn: No sign-in, a parent ticks for them
people.kids.minAgeMeta: Kids younger than this aren’t dealt it. Leave it empty for anyone.
people.kids.problems.name: Give their name.
people.kids.problems.born: Give the year they were born, like 2016. Kids are 18 or under.
people.kids.problems.minAge: Give an age from 2 to 18, or leave it empty.
people.delete.meta: Your name, email and photo go after {days} days. Also at jonz.app/delete.
people.delete.title: Delete your account?
people.delete.goes: your name, email, photo, reminders and sign-ins.
people.delete.stays: past Johns and the Stake ledger, shown as “Someone who left”.
people.delete.passAny: A House Pass you pay for stops renewing, and covers the house to the end of what was paid.
people.delete.pass: stops renewing. It covers the house until {until}.
people.delete.wait: You have {days} days to change your mind: sign in again and press Keep my account.
people.delete.reading: Checking what goes and what stays
people.delete.nothingGone: Until then nothing is gone, and your house still sees you as away.
people.delete.pageBody: Sign in with the account you use for Jonz, then confirm. It goes {days} days later, and until then you can change your mind.
people.delete.cantSignIn: Can’t sign in any more? Email support@jonz.app from the address on the account, and we’ll delete it for you.
people.delete.signInReason: Sign in to delete your account.
people.consent.heading: Let {app} use Jonz?
people.consent.body: {app} will use Jonz as you. You can change what it may do, or disconnect it, any time on You under Connected apps.
people.consent.goneBody: Go back to the app and connect again.
people.consent.signInReason: Sign in to connect an app to Jonz.
people.connectedApps.heading: Connected apps
people.connectedApps.confirm: Disconnect {app}? It signs out at once and has to ask again to come back.
people.appAccess.label: What can {app} do?
people.appAccess.readMeta: See your house, your Johns and what happened. It can’t change anything.
people.appAccess.writeMeta: Do what you can do, as you. Anything that can’t be undone still waits for you to approve it here.
people.connectClaude.title: Connect Jonz to Claude
people.connectClaude.meta: Ask Claude about your house, or let it mark Johns done for you.
people.connectClaude.step1: 1. On claude.ai, open Settings, then Connectors.
people.connectClaude.step2: 2. Tap Add custom connector. Call it Jonz and paste this address:
people.connectClaude.step3: 3. Claude sends you here to sign in. Pick what it may do, then tap Allow.
people.connectClaude.other: Any other app that speaks MCP connects the same way.
people.approve.heading: Approve this?
people.approve.body: An app you connected to Jonz asked to do this. It can’t be undone, so it waits for you.
people.approve.approvedBody: Go back to the app. It carries on from here.
people.approve.doneBody: The app has already done this.
people.approve.declinedBody: Nothing was changed, and the app won’t do it.
people.approve.expiredBody: Nothing was changed. Ask the app again if you still want it.
people.approve.unknown: This link doesn’t open a request
people.approve.unknownBody: It may be someone else’s. Check you’re signed in with the right account.
people.approve.signInReason: Sign in to approve a request from an app you connected.
